name: resizable
description: Resizable split panels the user can drag to resize, horizontal or vertical, built on react-resizable-panels. Use for split views like a code editor's sidebar/pane layout. Parts: ResizablePanelGroup (root, direction), ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle (withHandle for a visible grip).

keyboard.action: Move the separator to its supported extent.

aria: Handles expose separator semantics, orientation and value information.
consumer: Give handles an accessible label when adjacent panel context is ambiguous.
